findings.title: Batch tenant prefetch uses records that exclude tenantExternalIds
findings.failure: importCustomers always passes an empty tenantsByExternalId map into every importCustomer call, so CRM batch syncs never resolve tenantExternalIds: tenant–customer memberships are not created (or tenant-centric jobs skip customers as if no tenant matched).
findings.fix: Collect external IDs from records that have tenantExternalIds, e.g. inRecords.flatMap((r) => r.tenantExternalIds ?? []), not recordsWithTenantStubs (that filter keeps only records without tenantExternalIds).
findings.evidence: recordsWithTenantStubs is defined at lines 485-487 as records with tenantExternalIds undefined or length 0; getTenantsByExternalId at 510-512 flatMaps tenantExternalIds from that set, which is always []. importCustomer at 327-331 only reads the passed map and never queries. Litest importCustomers.tenants.litest.ts:107-152 and :348-374 assert memberships/import for tenantExternalIds via importCustomers.

findings.title: importCustomer no longer looks up tenants when batch map omitted
findings.failure: Callers that invoke importCustomer without tenantsByExternalId (importThreads.ts:140, importThreadMessage.ts, importAllCustomersAndUsersInRecords.ts) get an empty Map and never call getTenantsFromIdentifiers, so tenantExternalIds on embedded customers stop linking to tenants.
findings.fix: When args.tenantsByExternalId is undefined, keep the HEAD~1 behaviour: call tenantAggregate.getTenantsFromIdentifiers and fail on error. Use the map only when the batch path explicitly supplies it (non-undefined).
findings.evidence: Diff removes per-record lookup and replaces with args.tenantsByExternalId ?? new Map(); optional param defaults to empty, not to lookup. Grep importCustomer( shows no other caller passes tenantsByExternalId.

findings.title: upsertCustomer fast path ignores importedByJobDefinitionId
findings.failure: Nango importCustomers passes onUpdate: {} and importedByJobDefinitionId (importCustomers.ts:406-414). Existing customers whose fields match but importedByJobDefinitionId is null or stale used to get a write via shouldPerformCustomerUpsertUpdate(..., importedByJobDefinitionId) inside the transaction (lines 1025-1033); the fast path calls shouldPerform without the third argument, returns NOOP, and never sets importedByJobDefinitionId on the row.
findings.fix: Pass importedByJobDefinitionId into shouldPerformCustomerUpsertUpdate on the fast path, same as the transactional branch at line 1026.
findings.evidence: shouldPerformCustomerUpsertUpdate.ts:16-21 returns true when importedByJobDefinitionId differs from customer.importedByJobDefinitionId; tests at shouldPerformCustomerUpsertUpdate.test.ts:105-111. parseImportCustomer sets onUpdate: {} (importCustomers.ts:240). Fast path guard onUpdate.email === undefined && onUpdate.companyId === undefined matches CRM imports.

findings.title: Chunk tenant lookup errors swallowed
findings.failure: A failed getTenantsFromIdentifiers for one chunk logs a warning and continues; affected external IDs are treated as missing (no link or tenant-centric skip) instead of failing the import like the removed per-customer lookup did (scope.fail on lookupResult.isErr).
findings.fix: Return Result.err on first chunk failure, or aggregate failures and return err from getTenantsByExternalId so importCustomers aborts.
findings.evidence: getTenantsByExternalId always ends with Result.ok (line 290). Diff removed importCustomer failure on lookupResult.isErr. AGENTS.md: NEVER silently ignore errors — check every Result.

findings.title: Unreachable isErr checks after getTenantsByExternalId
findings.failure: Dead branches mislead maintainers; getTenantsByExternalId never returns Err.
findings.fix: Either make getTenantsByExternalId return Err on lookup failure and keep the check, or remove the isErr guard.
findings.evidence: Repo search on getTenantsByExternalId in importCustomers.ts: only Result.ok at line 290, no Result.err in the function.

findings.title: Optional batch map sentinel vs empty Map
findings.failure: Using ?? new Map() conflates “no batch prefetch” with “prefetch found nothing”, which caused removal of the inline lookup.
findings.fix: Type tenantsByExternalId as optional; undefined triggers legacy lookup, defined Map (including empty after a real batch query) uses map-only resolution.
findings.evidence: PR summary states single-customer callers keep per-customer lookup when no map is supplied; current code does not distinguish undefined from empty Map.

findings.title: NOOP fast path widens lock-free read window
findings.failure: More upserts return NOOP without withTransaction; concurrent writers can change the row between the read and a follow-up that assumed NOOP—same class of race as transactional path with selectForUpdate: false (comment at 670-672), but higher volume on CRM resyncs.
findings.fix: Accept as tradeoff or only fast-path when importedByJobDefinitionId and shouldPerform align; document for on-call.
findings.evidence: PR summary notes NOOP without locking races with concurrent writers. Transactional path already uses selectForUpdate: false.

findings.title: Rollback after bad deploy leaves membership gaps
findings.failure: If production runs with broken tenant resolution, customers can be created/updated without tenant memberships; rolling code back does not backfill memberships—a full CRM re-sync is needed.
findings.fix: Verify fix before merge; plan re-sync if this shipped.
findings.evidence: importCustomerTenantMemberships only runs when tenantsToLink.length > 0 (importCustomers.ts:442-450); broken map yields empty tenantsToLink.
